description: Create a unique multi-paragraph short story in seconds. Pick a genre, name your hero, add a keyword, then regenerate, copy or download.

faqs.a: Each genre has multiple variants for every story beat, combined at random — so Regenerate almost always produces a different story.
faqs.q: Are the stories really unique each time?

faqs.a: It becomes a key object in the tale (a map, a candle, a gadget). Leave it blank and the genre supplies a fitting default.
Yes — use “Copy” to grab the text, or “Download .txt” to save it as a file on your device.
faqs.q: Can I save a story I like?

howto: Choose a genre: Adventure, Horror, Sci-Fi, Funny or Fairy Tale.
Type your hero's name (or leave it blank for a random one).
Optionally add a keyword — like a magic object — to weave into the story.
Click “Generate Story”, hit “Regenerate” for a fresh tale, or copy/download your favorite.
title: Story Generator
